definition: heel floor = min heel world Y over the run (or bound loop); Y gate = floor + 0.02 m; speed gate = consecutive-sample heel XZ step <= 0.02 m/s * dt (dt = 1/30 s captures, clip sample dt offline); heel/toe plant = maximal >= 3-frame run with all frames Y-gated and all internal pairs speed-gated; heel span = max pairwise XZ distance over plant frames, m; stance = heel plant + max-overlap same-foot toe plant (>= 1 shared frame); order valid iff heel-strike < foot-flat < heel-off < toe-off (strict); fractions = (event - cycleStart)/(cycleEnd - cycleStart) over consecutive same-foot heel-strikes, null when open.
